fullPassage: There are reasons why science is not fully trusted and why healthy skepticism and critical thinking are essential. In spite of professional standards, claims of objectivity, and the peer review process, the conduct of science can be biased. All experts are not the same, nor do they submit their work to the same scrutiny. Knowing the source of funding can be important in evaluating scientific claims. For example, the Harvard researchers who made claims in the late 1960s about the problems with dietary fat, leading the nation away from perceiving sugar as one of the main causes in health problems, were funded in part by the sugar industry. The authors did not reveal their funding source to the New England Journal of Medicine, where their influential article appeared. Their article shaped a generation of changes in eating patterns that appears to have discouraged higher use of sugar, now widely implicated as a source of the rise in obesity and diabetes. Stories such as this one fuel suspicion — but also lead to further safeguards in the scientific process. Funding disclosures, although not required five decades ago, have since been made compulsory.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 건강한 회의주의(skepticism)와 비판적 사고가 필수적(essential)이다. 과학의 수행은 편향(biased)될 수 있다.

det.tip: skepticism(회의주의) ↔ credulity(맹신), essential(필수적) ↔ unnecessary(불필요한)

questions.passage: For example, the Harvard researchers who made claims in the late 1960s about the problems with dietary fat, leading the nation away from perceiving sugar as one of the main causes in health problems, were funded in part by the sugar industry. __________ Their article shaped a generation of changes in eating patterns that appears to have discouraged higher use of sugar, now widely implicated as a source of the rise in obesity and diabetes. Stories such as this one fuel suspicion — but also lead to further safeguards in the scientific process.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 쓰시오.

Their __________ article appeared in the New England Journal of Medicine. [influence]

det.korean: 명사 influence(영향)를 형용사 influential(영향력 있는)로 변환. 명사 article을 수식하므로 형용사 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ influential: influence(명사) → influential(형용사). 명사 수식에 형용사 필요
det.tip: influence(명사: 영향) → influential(형용사: 영향력 있는)

questions.passage: There are reasons why science is not fully trusted and why healthy skepticism and critical thinking are essential. __________ All experts are not the same, nor do they submit their work to the same scrutiny. Knowing the source of funding can be important in evaluating scientific claims.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 쓰시오.

In spite of claims of (object), the conduct of science can be biased.

det.korean: 명사 object를 명사 objectivity(객관성)로 변환. 전치사 of 뒤 추상 명사 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ objectivity: object(대상) → objective(객관적인) → objectivity(객관성)
det.tip: object(대상) → objective(객관적인, 형용사) → objectivity(객관성, 명사)

questions.passage: There are reasons why science is not fully trusted and why healthy skepticism and critical thinking are essential. In spite of professional standards, claims of objectivity, and the peer review process, the conduct of science can be biased. All experts are not the same, nor do they submit their work to the same ____. Knowing the source of funding can be important in evaluating scientific claims. For example, the Harvard researchers who made claims in the late 1960s about the problems with dietary fat, leading the nation away from perceiving sugar as one of the main causes in health problems, were funded in part by the sugar industry. The authors did not reveal their funding source to the New England Journal of Medicine, where their influential article appeared. Their article shaped a generation of changes in eating patterns that appears to have discouraged higher use of sugar, now widely implicated as a source of the rise in obesity and diabetes. Stories such as this one fuel suspicion — but also lead to further safeguards in the scientific process. Funding disclosures, although not required five decades ago, have since been made compulsory.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 모든 전문가가 같은 정밀 조사(scrutiny)를 받는 것이 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① scrutiny(정밀 조사): 전문가의 연구가 동일한 검증을 받지 않음
❌ ② admiration(감탄): 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ celebration(축하): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ compensation(보상): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: scrutiny = 정밀 조사. submit to scrutiny = 정밀 조사를 받다

The authors did not reveal their funding source to the New England Journal of Medicine, where their influential article appeared. Their article shaped a generation of changes in eating patterns that appears to have discouraged higher use of sugar, now widely implicated as a source of the rise in obesity and diabetes. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이런 이야기는 의심을 부추기지만 과학적 과정의 추가적 안전장치(safeguards)로도 이어진다.
det.analysis:
